title: Endpoint Telemetry: process_exit v1
description: Raw telemetry event emitted when a process terminates on an endpoint.

process_name.description: Process image name at time of exit.

process_path.description: Full filesystem path to the process executable.

pid.description: OS process identifier of the exited process.

exit_code.description: Process exit code as returned to the OS. 0 typically indicates normal exit.

duration_ms.description: Total process lifetime in milliseconds from start to exit.

file_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the process binary.
